title: Belavadós Player Map + Hidden DM Settlement Editor
notes: Use normal URL for players. Add #dm-editor for DM mode.
DM mode can import/export settlements, upload SVG maps, generate locations/NPCs, tweak names, and save to the player map.
Player mode has province/settlement selectors, live Earth/DM/Belavadós time, clickable map/location drawer, item-only search, and full NPC list.
